review_notes: Strong lane: existing Kani harness canonical_name_together_harness serves as regression gate. Source fix at part_05.rs:105 already applied. Obligation PO-xi2f29-001 command is exact with --no-unwind flag. Exhaustive coverage via PO-008.
Bounded verification of digest_step_primitive Together arm for deterministic hashing of branch count. Covered by PO-xi2f29-010 with concrete bounds (unwind=8, branch_count 1..=4).
Bounded verification of digest_sub_step recursion determinism. Covered by same PO-xi2f29-010. No duplicate harness needed.

Stack overflow check at MAX_LANGUAGE_NESTING_DEPTH=8 via kani::unwind(10). Concrete concrete bound with 2-slot margin. Covered by PO-xi2f29-009. Correctly trusts validation layer enforcing nesting before digest.
Exhaustive match verification via canonical_name_all_harness using kani::any(). GOD RULE compliant — no hardcoded inputs. Covered by PO-xi2f29-008.
End-to-end proptest through compile_source pipeline. Generates 2 vs 3 branch count workflows, asserts digest inequality. 1000 iterations. Covered by PO-xi2f29-002.
Proptest for branch label sensitivity: different labels → different digests. Empty strings, Unicode, long strings covered. Covered by PO-xi2f29-003.
Proptest for sub-step content sensitivity. Verifies digest_sub_step recursion. Covered by PO-xi2f29-004.
Proptest for branch ordering sensitivity: [a,b] vs [b,a] with different labels/contents. Covered by PO-xi2f29-005.
Proptest for deterministic digest: same source → same digest. Extends existing proptest_equal_primitive_sources_compile_to_equal_digest_and_ir. Covered by PO-xi2f29-006.
Regression gate: non-Together workflow digests unchanged. Full test suite gated. Covered by PO-xi2f29-007.

Solid not_applicable: canonical_digest is a single-step deterministic hash with no temporal behavior, queues, retries, leases, or distributed protocols. Evidence refs cite source lines + contract POST-007. Kani bounded verification provides stronger coverage on actual Rust implementation.

Solid not_applicable: structural inclusion properties (all fields hashed) are not complex invariants. Bounded recursion at MAX_LANGUAGE_NESTING_DEPTH=8 makes Kani exhaustive. Verus proof-engineering cost is disproportionate to properties. Evidence refs to concrete source and limits.

Solid not_applicable: digest properties are code-path-completeness (structural inclusion), not numeric refinement predicates. No refinement-type-expressible invariants. Kani and proptest provide stronger coverage. Evidence ref correctly notes contract clauses are structural, not refinement.

Solid not_applicable: no threads, atomics, channels, locks, or async interleaving in digest path. Pure single-threaded functions using only blake3::Hasher. Four evidence refs cite source lines, invariants, and contract POST-007.

Solid not_applicable: #![forbid(unsafe_code)] guards vb_compile. No raw pointers, FFI, or unsafe blocks in digest code. blake3 internal unsafe is upstream responsibility. Three evidence refs including invariants.yaml and source audit.

Solid not_applicable: digest hashes already-validated AST structures, not untrusted byte streams. Fuzzing would exercise blake3 internals, not our code. Proptest generates valid together configurations with stronger coverage. Evidence refs cite PRE-001 and non-goals.
Solid not_applicable: canonical_primitive_name is already verified by Kani exhaustive match (PO-xi2f29-008). Proptest adds no coverage beyond total enumeration of the 12-variant enum.
Solid not_applicable: PS-xi2f29-008 is explicitly a Kani proof execution seed. Proptest is not the right tool. Suggested_layers is [kani] only.
Solid not_applicable: recursion depth check at max nesting is covered by Kani with unwind(MAX_LANGUAGE_NESTING_DEPTH+2). Proptest at this depth is redundant.
Solid not_applicable: empty branch steps is a degenerate edge case with single defined behavior. Unit test PO-xi2f29-011 explicitly constructs and verifies. Kani would redundantly enumerate one path.

Solid not_applicable: nested together is a specific degenerate case of general recursion property. Covered by PO-009 (kani recursion) and PO-004 (proptest sub-step). Unit test PO-012 covers explicit construction. Separate Kani harness would duplicate.
